summary: This bill allows certain Venezuelan nationals who entered the U.S. before 2022 and have been continuously present for at least one year to apply for lawful permanent residency, waiving some inadmissibility grounds but excluding those with serious criminal convictions.

scores.thoughts: This bill is entirely focused on immigration, specifically creating a pathway to lawful permanent residency for certain Venezuelan nationals. It would lead to more individuals being lawfully admitted for permanent residence.
